documents.runbooks/deploy.md:
# Deployment Runbook
1. Run test suite
2. Build Docker image
3. Push to ECR
4. Update ECS task definition
5. Monitor CloudWatch for errors

Rollback: revert ECS task to previous revision
documents.runbooks/incident.md:
# Incident Response
1. Acknowledge in #incidents Slack channel
2. Assign incident commander
3. Diagnose root cause
4. Apply fix or rollback
5. Post-mortem within 48 hours
